definitions.explanation: The distance between successive crests of a wave, used in physics to describe light, sound, and other wave phenomena.

definitions.gloss: wavelength; compatibility; being on the same page
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe how well two people's personalities, thinking styles, or communication mesh together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: Red light has a long wavelength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{波長|はちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Ultraviolet light is light with a short wavelength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電磁波|でんじは}→電磁波：17900_denjiha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{波長|はちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The wavelength of electromagnetic waves varies greatly depending on the type.
I'm on the same wavelength as her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Even though we met for the first time, we were perfectly in sync.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧はどう⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなくて→合う：10466_au⟧、⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かみ{合|あ}わない。
examples.english: I just can't seem to get on the same wavelength as that person — our conversations never quite click.

notes:
Has both a scientific and a figurative meaning. The figurative sense — describing interpersonal compatibility — is extremely common in everyday Japanese and often more frequently encountered than the physics sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to be on the same wavelength; to click with someone
- {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: to not be on the same wavelength; to not click
- {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧/⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧: to have a long/short wavelength (physics)
- {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to be perfectly in sync

USAGE:
The figurative expression {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ describes a natural, effortless compatibility between people — the feeling that conversation and interaction flow smoothly without conscious effort. It is a very natural and idiomatic expression, not stiff or technical sounding.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{合|あ}う→気が合う：22839_kigaau⟧: to get along well — more general and common; focuses on temperament. {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ implies a deeper, more instinctive connection in thinking style.
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}がいい→相性がいい：22113_aishougaii⟧: good compatibility — often used for romantic relationships or fortune-telling contexts. More evaluative than {波長|はちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧.
